cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)

include(proj.conf)

find_package(bouffalo_sdk REQUIRED HINTS $ENV{BL_SDK_BASE})

sdk_add_include_directories(. main main/fonts main/wallpaper)

# Inter, generated by tools/gen_fonts.py. Text only - the LV_SYMBOL icons
# still come from LVGL's built-in Montserrat, which each of these falls back
# to for any glyph Inter does not carry.
file(GLOB BIKENAV_FONTS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/main/fonts/*.c)
file(GLOB BIKENAV_WALLPAPER ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/main/wallpaper/*.c)

target_sources(app PRIVATE
    ${BIKENAV_FONTS}
    ${BIKENAV_WALLPAPER}
    main/apple_link.c
    main/arrows.c
    main/ble_nav.c
    main/logbuf.c
    main/health.c
    main/backlight.c
    main/nav_state.c
    main/prefs.c
    main/ui.c
)

sdk_set_main_file(main/main.c)

project(bikenav)
